parsed.notes:
Required Qualifications defaults to required; Preferred Qualifications makes its items optional. Google Cloud is individually preferred despite appearing in the required section.
The highest degree named is the optional PhD. The separate required bachelor's qualification accepts equivalent applicable experience, so degree_or_equivalent is true.
Alternative groups encode mapped alternatives; additional alternatives among unmapped graph databases, query languages, matching tools, graph ML libraries, and governance tools remain documented in unmapped.
Machine learning and knowledge graphs are independently required elsewhere, so they do not remain grouped with alternatives in the initial experience qualification.
The isolated word 'data' in the experience qualification is not expanded into an unstated data-engineering skill. Domain knowledge, communication, and offshore-team experience are excluded.
GraphRAG maps to RAG, graph embeddings to Embeddings, and semantic data models to Data modeling. Graph-specific techniques without taxonomy entries are retained in unmapped.
Semantic-model versioning is not treated as ML model versioning. Model registry is likewise left unmapped rather than inferred to mean model versioning.
Technologies appearing only in responsibilities, including Vertex AI Pipelines, MLflow, Spanner Graph, APIs, and feature stores, are excluded.
